note: W-0904 波次：S1 TL1-E2E修复(session-3dd04da4) / S2 拨号E2E补全(session-fde372df)。协调会话=session-d86405ce。102 共享环境，带清理的 E2E 需错峰。

tasks.title: TL1 E2E 修复（S1 会话执行）
tasks.goal: 修复设备侧 record 证据断裂、清理段 SQL 三错、EXIT trap 退出码假绿，102 上三订单 E2E 全绿且造数清零
tasks.acceptanceCommand: bash -c 'if bash scripts/verify-tl1-e2e.sh > /tmp/tl1acc.log 2>&1 && grep -q "三订单通过" /tmp/tl1acc.log && ! grep -q "^ERROR:" /tmp/tl1acc.log; then echo TL1-ACC-OK; exit 0; else echo TL1-ACC-FAIL; tail -20 /tmp/tl1acc.log; exit 1; fi'

tasks.title: 开户与拨号上网 E2E 补全（S2 会话执行）
tasks.goal: mainchain 终态补认证账号一致与下发 SUCCESS 断言；新增 dial-acceptance 真实 RADIUS 三段认证（ACCEPT/停机REJECT/复机ACCEPT）且幂等可重复
tasks.acceptanceCommand: bash -c 'D=scripts/ops/dial-acceptance.sh; if [ ! -f "$D" ]; then echo DIAL-SCRIPT-MISSING; exit 1; fi; if bash scripts/ops/mainchain-acceptance.sh 2 > /tmp/mcacc.log 2>&1 && grep -q "认证账号" /tmp/mcacc.log && grep -q "SUCCESS" /tmp/mcacc.log && bash "$D" > /tmp/dialacc.log 2>&1 && bash "$D" > /tmp/dialacc2.log 2>&1; then echo DIAL-ACC-OK; exit 0; else echo DIAL-ACC-FAIL; tail -20 /tmp/mcacc.log /tmp/dialacc.log 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi'

tasks.title: 波次收口主树复核
tasks.goal: S1/S2 均合并回 main 后：主树 make check 通过 + 孤儿巡检门禁通过，确认 102 部署同步计划
tasks.acceptanceCommand: bash -c 'make check > /tmp/wave-check.log 2>&1 && bash scripts/ops/db-patrol-gate.sh > /tmp/wave-patrol.log 2>&1 && echo WAVE-OK || { echo WAVE-FAIL; tail -20 /tmp/wave-check.log /tmp/wave-patrol.log; exit 1; }'
